entry.name: jiraSite
entry.label: Jira Cloud site, e.g. https://your-company.atlassian.net

entry.name: jiraEmail
entry.label: Jira account email

entry.name: jiraToken
entry.label: Jira API token (NOT password)

entry.name: worklogPopupWidth
entry.label: Popup width in pixels

entry.name: worklogPopupHeight
entry.label: Popup height in pixels

entry.name: worklogShowSprintGauges
entry.label: Show the Sprint + Horas ring gauges below the calendar (9h mode only, Jira / Jira-Clockify sources only).

entry.name: worklogSprintField
entry.label: Jira issue field that holds the sprint array. Defaults to "sprint" which works on modern Jira Cloud; older instances may need a customfield_NNNNN id.

entry.name: worklogDailyTargetHours
entry.label: Daily target hours (used for the per-day diff in the totals row)

entry.name: worklogIssueJql
entry.label: JQL used to populate the issue picker in the new-worklog modal
entry.default: assignee = currentUser() AND statusCategory != Done ORDER BY updated DESC

entry.name: worklogIssueMax
entry.label: Max issues to show in the picker

entry.name: worklogShowIssueSummary
entry.label: Append the issue summary (title) after the key on each worklog block. The key is always shown.

entry.name: worklogSource
entry.label: Which calendar data source to render: "jira", "clockify" or "jira-clockify" (split).

entry.name: worklogPinned
entry.label: If true the popup stays open after focus loss (toggled by the pin button).

entry.name: worklogDebug
entry.label: Log every Jira request to plasmashell stdout

entry.name: clockifyApiKey
entry.label: Clockify API key (Profile → Settings → API)

entry.name: clockifyWorkspaceId
entry.label: Resolved workspace id (auto-filled after the first sync). Leave empty to use the user's default workspace.

entry.name: clockifyUserId
entry.label: Resolved Clockify user id (auto-filled).

entry.name: clockifyDefaultProjectId
entry.label: Optional project id to preselect in the new-entry modal and used by the Jira→Clockify sync.

entry.name: clockifyBillableDefault
entry.label: Default value of the "billable" toggle when creating a new Clockify entry.

entry.name: clockifyDebug
entry.label: Log every Clockify request to plasmashell stdout.
